info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-List Compliance Regulatory Compliances-spec
info.description: The Regulatory Compliance Listing API provides access to a comprehensive list of regulatory compliance requirements within the banking sector. This endpoint allows users to retrieve detailed information about various compliance regulations that financial institutions must adhere to. Typically utilized by compliance officers, legal teams, and auditors, this API supports informed decision-making and ensures adherence to legal standards. Use cases include regulatory assessment, compliance reporting, and audit preparation, making it an essential resource for maintaining compliance integrity.

get.description: This endpoint allows clients to retrieve information regarding compliance with regulatory standards relevant to our operations. It provides necessary details for understanding the current compliance status and any areas that may require attention.

requestBody.description: This request body contains the criteria and parameters required to retrieve regulatory compliance data. It should adhere to the specified schema to ensure proper processing.
